_note: K2: aim tunables (src/coach/derive/aim, src/coach/metrics/aim, src/coach/detect/aim). Distances in Source units, angles in degrees, times in ms. docs/coach/mechanics.md explains each.

shots._: Buttons are read over buttonWindowMs before each shot. A burst is consecutive bullets of one player and weapon with gaps ≤ burstGapCycles × the weapon's cycle time; a spray is sprayMin bullets or more.

target._: A bullet that hurt nobody is meant for the living enemy whose body (head, chest, pelvis) is nearest its zero-spread direction, inside max(baseDeg, atan(bodyRadius / distance)) + baseDeg, capped at maxDeg; with a map pack the enemy must be visible. The pick is clear when the runner-up is at least clearRatio times farther.

body._: The target silhouette for 'on target': half-width and the vertical extent above the feet, standing (scaled by the crouch like the hitboxes).

bands._: Distance bands (units) for the first-bullet and spray splits: below the first edge 'close', between 'mid', above the last 'long'.

counterStrafe._: First bullets (first of a burst, on the ground, target assigned). The Leetify-comparable figure counts rifles (kinds) and excludes crouched shots (duck ≥ crouchDuck). A shot is early above moveFraction × the weapon's max speed. lateCapMs: the longest look-ahead for the speed to drop. Finding: a fix when the share is ≥ fixShare and in the lobby's bottom half; costHit = how much less likely a moving first bullet hits (fights per early shot); precision before K11 measures it.

spray._: Bullets from bulletFrom on in sprays of sprayMin+ with a target. Offsets (degrees) of the zero-spread direction from the target's chest, up and right positive. A bucket of bullets is 'off' when its median offset is beyond the body silhouette's angular half-size and at least offDeg. Finding: a fix when the on-target share is in the bottom half and ≥ minBullets bullets; costPerSpray fights per drifting spray.

rangeDiscipline._: Sprays of minBullets+ at a target beyond longUnits that hit nothing after bullet afterBullet.

firstBullet._: First bullets with a target: hit rate overall, standing against moving (moving = above the counter-strafe threshold), per band. A fix when in the lobby's bottom half with gapToMedian below the lobby median; costPerMiss fights per extra miss.
